notes:
Best-contactable doctor in this batch - the only one with a verified direct phone AND email. Distinctive surname (Koyyoda), no same-name ambiguity found.

IDENTITY: verified on four criteria across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL DOMAINS that agree - (1) apollohospitals.com, which publishes three separate pages for him (Hyderabad region doctor page, GI & General Surgery departmental page, International Patient Services page) naming him Surgical Gastroenterologist at Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad; and (2) apollo247.com, Apollo's own booking platform, with a doctor-specific page. That matches the input row on name + specialty + hospital (Apollo Hospitals) + address (Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills) + city. His Practo listing independently places him in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad. Note apollo247.com counts as an official source in its own right under the grading rules, so this is genuinely two official sources and not one domain counted twice - I did not treat the three apollohospitals.com pages as three sources.

SPECIALTY NUANCE: the input row says 'Gastroenterology & Hepatology' while Apollo files him under GI & General Surgery / 'Surgical Gastroenterologist'. These are consistent, not contradictory - he holds MCh Surgical Gastroenterology and appears on Apollo's own 'Gastroenterology & Hepatology, Hyderabad' booking category page. He is a SURGICAL gastroenterologist (operating HPB/GI surgeon), not a medical gastroenterologist doing endoscopy alone; anyone using this record for outreach should pitch accordingly.

PHONE AND EMAIL - BOTH PASSED THE MANDATORY EXACT-PHRASE CHECK, AND ARE INSTITUTIONAL. A search summary first asserted the number +91 93476 65652 alongside a Banjara Hills clinic address. I did NOT record it on that basis. Per section 4 I re-searched the bare digit string '9347665652' in quotes: it came back attached to supraclinic.in - a real indexed clinic website with a dedicated /contact/ page - confirming it as the published reception/appointment line of Supra Gastro & Surgery Clinic. I then separately exact-phrase searched 'contactsupraclinic@gmail.com', which likewise came back on multiple supraclinic.in pages including /contact/. BOTH VALUES ARE THEREFORE VERBATIM-CONFIRMED ON THE PRACTICE'S OWN WEBSITE, not stitched together by a summary. On the institutional-only rule: this is a CLINIC RECEPTION line and a CLINIC BUSINESS mailbox, which section 3 expressly permits, not a personal mobile or private inbox. Two caveats a human should note: the number is in an Indian MOBILE series (Indian single-doctor clinics routinely publish a mobile as the practice line, and it is presented on the site as the clinic's line, not as anyone's cell), and the email is a gmail.com address rather than a domain mailbox - but its local part 'contactsupraclinic' is unambiguously the clinic's shared business address. I found no Apollo-issued email or direct Apollo extension for him and did NOT derive one from the apollohospitals.com domain.

HOW THE CLINIC WAS TIED TO HIM (not assumed): his own branded site drprashanthkoyyoda.com lists a secondary consulting location at 'Anushka Pride, Road No. 12, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad 500034'; Supra Gastro Clinic's published address is 'Anushka Pride building, Road No. 12, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad 500034' - same building, same road, same PIN. supraclinic.in names its lead clinician 'Dr. K. Prashanth', Surgical Gastroenterologist, where K is the Koyyoda initial (Skedoc lists him under exactly that abbreviated form). Address + specialty + name-initial all agree, so owns_clinic is set TRUE on evidence rather than inference. Clinic founded June 2019.

DO NOT MERGE: 'Dr. P. Sushma' / Dr. Sushma Peruri (drsushmaperuri.com) is a SEPARATE doctor - a proctology specialist who co-leads the same clinic. Her site shares the clinic email, which is why it surfaced on my email check. None of her details have been recorded here. Also note two alternate spellings encountered in directories: 'Koyyada' (Sasthya Seba) and 'Dr Prashanth Koyyoda' with the name order reversed (Practo, his own domain) - all the same man.

EXPERIENCE DISCREPANCY FLAGGED FOR REVIEW: input says 16+ years, his own site says 15+, Apollo 24|7 and aggregators say 9. See verified_experience. No LinkedIn profile, ORCID, Google Scholar or ResearchGate page surfaced for him in any query, and I did not construct or guess any of them - those fields are blank. Unlike the transplant/oncology rows in this batch, no publications appeared for him either. The Facebook entry is the CLINIC's page (a practice account, which the Tier-3 rules permit as professional use), not a personal profile.
